pkgmetadata.longdescription:
eSpeak NG is a compact formant speech synthesizer, also used as the text-to-phoneme front end of neural voices such as Piper and Kokoro.
This is a temporary mirror of the ::gentoo package, pinned to the commit app-text/calibre needs for its neural Read aloud engine: no release has espeak_TextToPhonemesWithTerminator() yet. Remove it once ::gentoo ships one that does.

use.flag: Enables Klatt formant synthesis and implementation
Builds extended Chinese (Mandarin and Cantonese) Dictionary files
Enable audio speed up support with media-libs/sonic
